narr: Scattered thunderstorms associated with a surface trough produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central Virginia and the Virginia Northern Neck.
ev: Road was closed due to high water on Nomini Grove Road near the intersection with Kings Highway.
About 18 inches of water was on the roadway near the intersection of Cary Street and Arthur Ashe Boulevard.
Kings Highway was closed between Nomini Grove and Templeman due to high water.
Virginia Department of Transportation web camera indicated flooding at the corner of Belvidere Street and Canal Street. More than six inches of water was on the roadway.
